method_notes: COMPLETE dry-run. Sweep: Datacom, CDC NZ, DCI, Spark/TenPeaks, Chorus, Plan B, Equinix, AirTrunk, Vantage, STACK, NTT, STT GDC, NEXTDC, Microsoft, Google, AWS, Meta, Apple, Datagrid, plus Auckland suburbs / Hamilton / Wellington / Christchurch / Makarewa Southland.

Grain kept: IT ≠ facility power ≠ interconnection ≠ generation/PPA. Do not copy Microsoft Te Huka 3 51.4 MW generation / Contact PPA as campus MW. Do not copy Spark/TenPeaks national 23 MW / 130 MW+ portfolio onto one pin. Do not copy CDC Auckland region '220 MW + capacity' glance as a campus.

Sub-250 disclosed pins kept (Datacom 10/10/14, CDC 22/22/54, TenPeaks South 12.3, TenPeaks North 40). Equinix IBX hold; no NZ xScale named place found. Soft corridors HOLD (NEXTDC AK1 Auckland-alone).
